label: Screen Melt
blurb: The screen melt from classic shooters: the picture slides down the screen in narrow columns, each one starting a moment after its neighbour, and the next clip drops in from the top the same way. Drips gives soft, wavy runs instead of hard columns. Put it on both clips of a cut, or use Progress to key it by hand; the track below shows as the picture melts away.

params.label: When
choices: In at the start and out at the end
